item.description:
Your next meeting, in the menu bar

  • Turn on Meetings in the menu bar (Settings → Gmail) to see your next meeting at a glance: “Standup in 8m”, then “Join Standup”.
  • When a call with other people is about to start, the icon pulses. Join is one click away, for Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex links.
  • The panel also lists your later meetings today and opens any of them in Cove.

It’s off by default, and it stays still with Reduce Motion.

More than one account

  • Sign in to several Google accounts and switch between them from the account menu (or ⌃1–⌃9). Each keeps its own mail, agents, tasks and From address.
  • Add a work account with your organization's own Google client, so your whole Google Workspace can sign in.
  • While Google sign-in waits, a bar lets you copy the link for another browser, open it again, or cancel.
  • Agent activity on the Agents screen now leads with the label, so long subjects no longer hide it.

Your current sign-in moves over automatically the first time you open this version.

Quieter when your Mac is locked

  • If Cove needs your AI key while your Mac is locked (or Touch ID can't be shown because Cove is in the background), it no longer interrupts you with an alert. The status line says AI is paused, and the work picks up again on the next sync.

Nothing is sent without you.
